register: # SOURCES: Afore T4 communication protocol PDF (AFORE_T4.pdf), holding registers 0-15. The same 16 holding registers are read by the Afore BNTxxxKTL-2mppt Solarman definition, so this block is layout-independent.

# STATIC: versions, serial number, grid regulation, communication address, language and the grid connection limits change rarely and are read once per connection (startup). Everything is read-only here: the PDF allows writes (FC06), but a wrong grid regulation, limit or address can take the inverter off the grid or off the bus.

note: INFERRED: the PDF shows Sn[0]..Sn[15] packed two characters per byte, so the value is read as hexadecimal digits across 4 registers. Compare with the label on the inverter; Sn[14] is documented as reserved.
Grid safety standard; names in grid_regulation_codes in the protocol JSON. The PDF lists Malaysia as 0x1D, a duplicate of Austria; 0x1E is the unused value between them and is used here.

High byte of the first time register: year as an offset from 2000. UNCONFIRMED byte order: the PDF's write table lists year, month, day, hour, minute, second (followed here) but its read table lists the notes in a different order. Read-only here; set the clock on the inverter.
Low byte of the first time register.
High byte of the second time register.
Low byte of the second time register.
High byte of the third time register.
Low byte of the third time register.
Modbus slave address, 1-32. Writable in the PDF but read-only here; changing it drops the link.
Lower grid voltage limit for connecting; set by the grid regulation.
Upper grid voltage limit for connecting; set by the grid regulation.
Lower grid frequency limit for connecting; set by the grid regulation.
Upper grid frequency limit for connecting; set by the grid regulation.
